name: San Marino Historic Centre and Mount Titano
description: Perched on the slopes and summit of Mount Titano, the old town of San Marino is the capital of one of the world's smallest republics, which has governed itself since the 13th century. Walking its lanes, you pass medieval towers, walls and gates, a neo-classical basilica and the 19th-century Palazzo Publico. It is still a living town, where government continues to operate.
